name: Ad Infinitum
text: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card. At the end of that turn, if you didn't play it, it deals damage to you equal to its mana value. You may repeat this process any number of times.
flavorText: "The best part of this job is getting fired."

name: Artistic Strike
text: This spell deals 3 damage to any target, including a spell on the stack (If it deals enough damage to a creature or planeswalker spell, it's countered. If it's a Battle, it enters transformed.)
flavorText: A lot of Prismari students start off with a bright idea, only to be shut down by an even brighter one.

name: Astral Force
text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn.
{2}{U}: Until end of turn, this enchantment becomes a 1/1 Monk creature with prowess and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card." in addition to its other types until end of turn.

name: Bloodrush Bellow
text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains haste and berserk until end of turn. (Whenever it attacks, you may double its power. If you do, sacrifice it at the end of turn.)
{4}{R/G}{R/G}, Discard a creature card: Add the discarded creature card's power, toughness and text box to target attacking creature until end of turn.

name: Collectric Blast
text:
Collectric Blast deals 2 damage to any target.
Collection — Collectric Blast deals 4 damage instead if you control three or more differently named tokens.
flavorText: Collectomancy is part art, part science, and all fun.

name: Crash Bandicoot!
text: {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}: Destroy target artifact. If an artifact is put into a graveyard this way, put a shield counter on Crash Bandicoot! Then, if Crash Bandicoot! has three or more shield counters on him, untap him and until end of turn, he must be blocked by all creatures if able. (You literally tap him 450 degrees. Make it look good.)

name: Determined
text: Discard a nonland card. If you do, draw two cards.

name: Everything, at Once
text: Exile your graveyard. Until the end of your next turn, you may play cards exiled this way.

name: Go Out With a Bang
text: Target creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn. When it dies this turn, exile it. Its controller creates a token that's a copy of it, except it's an enchantment.
flavorText:
"Please remember me at my best, but most of all, remember me at my worst."
— Judith, the Magnificent Death

name: Guilty Gear
text:
Strive — This spell costs {2}{B} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
Until end of turn, whenever you sacrifice a token, it deals 1 damage to each opponent.
Choose any number of target artifact and/or creature cards with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of it, except it has haste. Sacrifice those tokens at the beginning of the next end step.

name: I Want It All
text: Exile your hand and the top seven cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may play cards exiled this way.
flavorText:
"A torturous existence indeed—to taste everything, yet taste nothing."
—Elspeth, to Xenagos

name: Jaxis Taxis
text:
Whenever this Vehicle attacks, you may sacrifice X differently named tokens. If you do, you may put a creature card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. It gains "When this creature dies, draw a card." Sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step.
Blitz {R} (If you cast this spell for its blitz cost, it gains haste and "When this artifact dies, draw a card." Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.)
Crew 1

name: Leave No Turn Unstoned
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile a card at random from your graveyard. You may cast a copy of that card this turn.
flavorText:
"All truths are seeded in your mind — your path is simply the journey of remembrance."
—The Burning-Tree Sisterhood, to Judith

name: Look for Fossils
text:
Return a card [at random] from your graveyard to your hand.
Flashback-Cleave {2}{G}{G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback-cleave cost. If you do, remove the words in square brackets. Then exile it.)

name: Nightmare Halls
text: Rather than pay the mana cost for a spell, its controller may discard a card that shares a color with that spell.
flavorText: "Madness is not a problem, Fran. It's a gift."

name: Pyromancer's Mentor
text: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a Young Pyromancer token. (It's a {1}{R} 2/1 Human Shaman creature with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token.")

name: Raga-Van, Nimble Pilferer
text:
Whenever Raga-Van deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token and exile the top card of that player's library. Until end of turn, you may cast that card.
Dash {1}{R} (You may cast this spell for its dash cost. If you do, it gains haste, and it's returned from the battlefield to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.)
Crew 3

name: Regal Rooster
text:
Flying, menace, haste
When this creature enters, mill cards until you mill an enchantment card. Create a tapped Treasure token for each card milled this way, and put that enchantment into your hand.
{2}{R}, Discard this card: You become the monarch.

name: Shocking Revelation
text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may behold a card with mana value 6 or more. (You may choose a permanent you control with mana value 6 or more or reveal a card with mana value 6 or more from your hand.)
Shocking Revelation deals 2 damage to any target. If you beheld, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.

name: Song of Hero's Past
text: Add {R} for each creature card in your graveyard.
flavorText:
"I sing of warriors lost to night,
Their flames snuffed out, yet set to light.
Across the Realms, their names shall roar,
The fire wakes and burns once more."
—Birgi, God of Storytelling

name: Sort Yourself Out
text:
(You protect this battle. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a defense counter from it. If you remove the last counter this way, exile it, then cast it transformed.)
At the beginning of your end step, discard a card, then draw a card.

name: Titan of Stars Aligned
text:
Resonance for enchantments (This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the total mana value of enchantments you control.)
Trample
This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the total mana value of other enchantments you control.
flavorText: When the skies of Theros were formed, he was there, watching.

name: Unlock Creativity
text:
Fill the blanks with "custom" and "noncustom". Use each word only once.
Add {R} for each ___, nonland, nontoken permanent you control.
Exile the top card of your library for each ___, nonland, nontoken permanent you control. You may play them this turn.

name: Unlucky Strike
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have exactly thirteen cards in your graveyard, sacrifice this enchantment and it deals 13 damage to each opponent.
{2}{R}, Exile a card from your graveyard: This enchantment deals 1 damage to each opponent.

name: Visionary of Unfathomable Sights
text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Titanform 7 (7, Exile this card from your hand: Cast a copy of it, except it's a 8/8 Eldrazi in addition to its other types. Activate only as a sorcery.)
When this creature enters or attacks, discard cards equal to its toughness, then draw cards equal to its power.

name: Whisper Twice
text:
Add {G}{U}{R}.
Harmonize {4}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its harmonize cost. You may tap a creature you control to reduce that cost by {X}, where X is its power. Then exile this spell.)
flavorText:
"Let the Jeskai meditate in silence—a silence that will be broken as easily as their bones."
—Taki, Temur Whisperer

name: Wild Speculation
text:
Buyback {2} (You may pay an additional {2} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
Choose a card type and name a card. Shuffle, then reveal the top card of your library. If it's the chosen type, draw it. If it's the named card, instead you may cast it without paying its mana cost.

name: Yamper
text:
Pokémon (Instead of playing a land, you may exile a land card from your hand. Lands exiled this way can be tapped to activate this creature's activated abilities. They can't be activated any other way.)
Zap — !{R}!, {T}: This creature deals 1 damage to target creature. Put a stun counter on it.
